name: Protocol Smile
source:
Jade is a former idol – namely because all the other humans are dead, so there’s no one left for her to perform for. 

But hey, at least she has her robot friends to keep her company… right?

[From [url=https://smushy64.itch.io/bog-jam-summer-2025]Itch.io[/url]]

但是，嘿，至少她有机器人朋友陪伴她……对吧？
